title: Deskline — Support Tickets
objective: A single ticket update correctly checks that it is yours. Change the status of a ticket that belongs to someone else using the bulk-update feature.

verifier.condition: A batch update actually changes a ticket belonging to a user other than the caller.

weakness: The bulk ticket-update endpoint checks that each ticket id in the batch exists, but never that it belongs to the caller, while the single-ticket update endpoint checks ownership correctly.
seededData: Two users, each with their own support tickets; ticket ids are simple and sequential. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Has two of her own support tickets.

hints: Try changing a single ticket that is not yours the normal way, and read how that is refused.
Now look at the bulk-update feature. Does it refuse the same thing the single-ticket endpoint does?
Send a batch update whose list of ticket ids includes one that is not yours.
burpNotes: Capture the bulk-update request from the 'close all my resolved tickets' button and edit the list of ids it sends.
